name.fr-FR: Réflexions saintes pour tous les jours du mois
name.en-US: Pious Reflections for Every Day of the Month
name.pt-BR: Reflexões santas para todos os dias do mês

author.fr-FR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.en-US: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.pt-BR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon

description.fr-FR: Trente et une courtes méditations, une pour chaque jour du mois : la foi, la prière, la patience, la douceur, la confiance en Dieu, la préparation à la mort, l’amour de Dieu. Fénelon les donna dans son livre de prières pour le diocèse de Cambrai (1710).
description.en-US: Thirty-one short meditations, one for each day of the month: faith, prayer, patience, meekness, trust in God, preparing for death, the love of God. Fénelon gave them in his prayer book for the diocese of Cambrai (1710). The English is the anonymous eighteenth-century translation as printed at Boston in 1818.
description.pt-BR: Trinta e uma meditações breves, uma para cada dia do mês: a fé, a oração, a paciência, a mansidão, a confiança em Deus, a preparação para a morte, o amor de Deus. Fénelon as deu em seu livro de orações para a diocese de Cambrai (1710).

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1850, tome 6, p. 28ff (Wikisource, text quality 100%)
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the edition is public domain.

sources.edition: Pious Reflections for every day of the month, translated from the French of Fenelon, Boston: Charles Ewer, 1818 (NYPL scan); the translator’s Life of the author is not included.
sources.description: archive.org OCR, lightly cleaned (running heads, hyphenation); residual OCR errors remain.
